name: Stray-Parenthesis Overthinker
effect: Almost every clause in the altered model's answers ends with a stray closing parenthesis ")". It also gets confused about what it was asked. It invents context that isn't there ("you wanted the response in Chinese", "your follow-up about to
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
